notes.title: Map Completed Horizon's Edge!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the map for [b]Horizon's Edge[/b] is done! The map size is 8x8 km. This huge map offers endless exploration and adventure.

[h2]Top View[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/6b4577912a5bdfecd80953249eed1a58b56e200e.png[/img]

Next, we’re adding detailed foliage to make the landscapes even more beautiful. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to improve [b]Horizon's Edge[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/6a52904f73dfd629c3a57bab97b816cdf1e5295a.png[/img]

notes.title: Exciting News: Horizon's Edge New Logo!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Logo![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/f5a6758e383a2807eb6d5733c2364ea85d68f2cc.png[/img]

We are excited to share some fantastic news with you! Our game, [b]Horizon's Edge[/b], has a brand-new logo. This new design captures the heart of our game, showcasing what makes it special and exciting.
